title: TokenWright inference projection
description: Read-only projection of one TokenWright box's inference engine, except for the `desired` block. Secret-free by construction: no credential, token, endpoint outside loopback, prompt, completion, or request body may appear in any field.

desired.description: The box's desired state, and the only editable block. The box reconciles toward it, including at boot — systemd's enablement state is not a second source of truth. A command that sets one of these fields writes it here and then reconciles, so a button and a literal edit cannot diverge.

model.description: Model id the engine should hold loaded. Null means unload. Must be one of `models` — a box cannot be asked to load something it was never asked to hold.

autostart.description: Whether the engine starts with the machine. The supervisor always does.

direct_access.description: Whether the WireGuard model surface is brought up. GaugeDesk never uses that path; this is for the operator's own tools.

models.description: The models this box should hold. The box downloads what is missing. Removing an id does not delete anything: the model becomes `orphaned` and is freed only by an explicit prune, because a declarative list is a poor place to lose four hundred gigabytes by a typo.

status.description: When stopped or failed, `model` is null throughout and `throughput` is zeroed — engine facts cross a process boundary, so the document says the engine is down rather than showing stale values as live. `hardware` stays live; the supervisor reads it and does not need the engine.

listen.description: Loopback bind address of the engine itself. A non-loopback value is a defect, not a configuration; the WireGuard model surface is a separate listener reported in the posture document.

uptime.description: Human-readable, e.g. "3d 14h". Null when not running.

last_error.description: Last lifecycle failure. Never a request-scoped error, which could carry content.

model.description: The currently loaded model. All fields null when none is loaded.

state.description: `orphaned` was dropped from desired.models and still occupies disk. `quarantined` failed its digest and will not be loaded.

digest_verified.description: Whether the file matched its recorded digest at last check. Null while downloading.

throughput.description: Counts and rates only, never per-request detail. There is no queue by design: the engine admits up to max_concurrent and rejects beyond it at the API. rejected_overload_total is therefore a first-class signal, not an error count — a box that never rejects is under-loaded and one that rejects constantly is under-sized.

max_concurrent.description: Concurrent generations admitted. Beyond this the API rejects rather than queues.

rejected_overload_total.description: Requests refused for being over max_concurrent.

events.description: Engine lifecycle events only — start, stop, model load/unload, update, hardware fault. A request-scoped log line may never be projected here: it can carry prompt or completion text.

storage.description: Capacity for model weights. Without this a download that fills the volume is invisible until something else fails.
